title: Discobox
description: discobox: Netdisco → Netbox sync, jobs and gaps

panels.title: Sync paused
panels.description: POST /sync/pause, or the auto-pause after repeated failures.

panels.title: Devices with errors
panels.description: Last sync completed, but parts of it failed (APs, IPs, modules, notes, …).

panels.title: Orphan brake
panels.description: Devices whose orphan interface cleanup was held back by the delete brake.

panels.title: Skipped / h by reason
panels.description: cooldown / in_progress / queue_full are dropped before queuing; discovery_incomplete, recently_touched and pinned skip a started sync. queue_full deserves an alert.

panels.title: Errors, timeouts, retries / h
panels.description: Errors inside syncs that still complete count in discobox_sync_errors_total, not as an error sync.

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: gaps → discover-missing / fix-tags act on the last gaps result; types-bare reads bare types from Netbox. Also on the discobox status page and GET /jobs.

panels.title: Netbox devices
panels.description: reconcile.roles / statuses with a primary IP.

panels.title: Excluded
panels.description: Netbox devices matching reconcile.exclude: never pushed to Netdisco.

panels.title: Offline
panels.description: Not in Netdisco, and liveness reports them down: not enqueued.

targets.legendFormat: hooks for devices not in Netbox

panels.title: Wireless APs / h
panels.description: not_found: the WLC reports an AP Netbox doesn't have (alerted after 24h).

panels.title: Bare DeviceTypes / ModuleTypes (source=netdisco)
panels.description: Created by discobox without templates. library=available: POST /types/library fills it; none: fix by hand or upstream to the devicetype-library.

targets.expr: max by (kind, manufacturer, model, part_number, library) (discobox_types_bare)

panels.title: Deprecated endpoint calls / h
panels.description: Callers still using an old endpoint; should stay empty.

panels.title: Devices: last sync
panels.description: Per device (name from the hook, else IP). Sort by a column to find failing or slow devices.
